# Jimmy Ramani — Full Stack Developer & Software Engineer

> Portfolio of Jimmy Ramani, a Full Stack Developer with 2.6+ years of experience building scalable web applications and AI-enabled solutions using React.js, Next.js, Angular, and Node.js, with cloud and DevOps experience.

This is a single-page React portfolio hosted on GitHub Pages. Content is public and may be summarized or cited with a link back to the source page.

## Pages

- [Home](https://jimmy-ramani-0912.github.io/portfolio/): About, skills, experience, projects, education, blogs, timeline and contact form.
- [Projects](https://jimmy-ramani-0912.github.io/portfolio/projects): Full list of projects with descriptions, tech tags and links.
- [Blogs](https://jimmy-ramani-0912.github.io/portfolio/blogs): Technical articles on React, Next.js, state management, MongoDB and code quality.
